description: This Java class defines the context for alarm status subscriptions within the Thingsboard server, managing subscription creation, updates, and fetching active alarms.

classes.name: TbAlarmStatusSubCtx
classes.description: Context class managing alarm status subscriptions, including creation, updates, and alarm fetching.

methods.name: isDynamic
methods.description: Indicates whether the subscription context is dynamic; returns false.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the subscription context and cancels the associated subscription.

methods.name: createSubscription
methods.description: Creates a new alarm status subscription based on the provided command.

methods.name: sendUpdate
methods.description: Sends an update message about the current alarm status.

methods.name: fetchActiveAlarms
methods.description: Fetches active alarms from the database and updates the subscription.

methods.name: handleAlarmStatusSubscriptionUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to the alarm subscription, adding or removing alarms based on incoming updates.
